title: Lakehouse: chaos process-kill a MinIO node (EC tolerates 1)
description: Runs `nexus chaos lakehouse process-kill --duration 15 --yes`. Process-kills nexus-minio on a MinIO node; the EC:2 set tolerates one lost node (the cluster health stays 200 during the window), then the service restarts and the adapter polls /minio/health/cluster back to 200.

observe.what: observed-impact during the kill (minio-live 3/4, 1 drive offline) while minio-cluster stays 200 — EC tolerance — then cluster recovered = true

whatProves: LakehouseAdapter.ApplyChaosAsync runs the embedded nexus-chaos.sh on a MinIO node (the EC:2 set tolerates one node loss) and recovers via a /minio/health/cluster poll; the VIP holder + ALIVE Spark master are spared.
